uuid.description: Unique key for the equipment specification

companyEquipmentSpecificationId.description: Ivo Systems company equipment specification id

specificationDescription.description: Short description of the equipment specification

isActive.description: Boolean flag indicating if the equipment specification is active/inactive

isDeleted.description: Boolean flag indicating if the equipment specification is deleted/inactive

createdTimestampUtc.description: Utc timestamp generated when the equipment specification was created

createdByUserId.description: Ivo Systems user id that created the equipment specification - default 45 (IVO Systems User)
